units.title: Wet-gate scanning
units.text: A film-scanning method that temporarily fills surface scratches with a compatible liquid during capture so many scratches become less visible in the digital image.

units.title: Cleaning before scanning
units.text: Before film enters the scanner, loose dust must be removed, damaged splices must be repaired and the technician must confirm that no wet cleaning solvent remains on the film.

units.title: Reference grading
units.text: The restoration colourist compares the scan with approved reference material and documents grading decisions when density or colour balance requires adjustment.

units.title: Shrinkage measurement
units.text: Film shrinkage is measured before transport through precision equipment because excessive shrinkage can damage perforations or cause unstable registration.

units.title: Repairing a cement splice
units.text: The technician trims the damaged ends, aligns the perforations, applies the approved cement and waits for the joint to set before testing the repair.
